message.content: The Duchy of Normandy was established in 911 by Viking ruler Rollo, who received the territory from King Charles III of West Francia under the Treaty of Saint-Clair-sur-Epte. Later, under Richard I of Normandy, it was forged into a cohesive and formidable feudal principality.
